name: Senado Brasil MCP
description: MCP server for the Brazilian Federal Senate open data (Dados Abertos): senators, bills, votes, committees, agenda and e-Cidadania participation.
author: Sidney Bissoli

tools.name: senado_listar_senadores
tools.description: List senators in office or for a given legislature; filter by state and party.

tools.name: senado_obter_senador
tools.description: Get detailed info on a senator: biography, mandates and committees.

tools.name: senado_buscar_senador_por_nome
tools.description: Search senators by name (when you don't have the code).

tools.name: senado_votacoes_senador
tools.description: List a senator's votes, showing how they voted on each matter.

tools.name: senado_buscar_materias
tools.description: Search legislative matters by type (PEC, PL, PLP, MPV), number, year, keywords, author or rapporteur.

tools.name: senado_obter_materia
tools.description: Get full details of a legislative matter: summary, authorship, current status, rapporteur.

tools.name: senado_tramitacao_materia
tools.description: Get a matter's processing history in chronological order.

tools.name: senado_textos_materia
tools.description: Get a matter's available texts (initial, substitute, final) with download URLs.

tools.name: senado_votos_materia
tools.description: Get a matter's voting results, including tally and nominal votes when available.

tools.name: senado_listar_votacoes
tools.description: List Senate floor votes by year; filter by month or period.

tools.name: senado_obter_votacao
tools.description: Get details of a specific vote, including each senator's nominal vote.

tools.name: senado_votacoes_recentes
tools.description: Get the most recent floor votes (last N days).

tools.name: senado_listar_comissoes
tools.description: List Senate committees; filter by type (permanent, temporary, CPI, joint) and status.

tools.name: senado_obter_comissao
tools.description: Get committee details, including chair, vice-chair and purpose.

tools.name: senado_membros_comissao
tools.description: List current committee members and their roles.

tools.name: senado_reunioes_comissao
tools.description: List a committee's scheduled or held meetings with date, time, place and agenda.

tools.name: senado_agenda_plenario
tools.description: Get the Senate floor session agenda, including matters to be voted.

tools.name: senado_agenda_comissoes
tools.description: Get the committee meeting agenda; filter by date and committee.

tools.name: senado_legislatura_atual
tools.description: Return info on the current legislature (number, period, start/end dates).

tools.name: senado_tipos_materia
tools.description: List valid legislative matter types with acronym, full name and description.

tools.name: senado_partidos
tools.description: List parties currently represented in the Senate with seat counts.

tools.name: senado_ufs
tools.description: List federation units with the number of senators currently in office per state.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_listar_consultas
tools.description: List e-Cidadania public consultations with citizen voting on matters in progress.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_obter_consulta
tools.description: Get details of a public consultation, including votes, author and comments.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_consultas_polarizadas
tools.description: Return consultations with balanced (~50/50) voting - polarized topics.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_consultas_consensuais
tools.description: Return consultations with high agreement (>85%) - consensus topics.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_listar_eventos
tools.description: List interactive e-Cidadania events (public hearings, sabatinas, lives).

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_obter_evento
tools.description: Get details of an interactive event, including agenda, guests and video link.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_eventos_populares
tools.description: Return events with the most citizen comments and questions.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_listar_ideias
tools.description: List legislative ideas proposed by citizens on e-Cidadania.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_obter_ideia
tools.description: Get details of a legislative idea, including support and whether it became a bill.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_ideias_populares
tools.description: Return the most-supported citizen legislative ideas.

tools.name: senado_ecidadania_sugerir_tema_enquete
tools.description: Analyze and suggest monthly poll themes, avoiding overly polarized or fully consensual topics.

resources.name: tipos-materia
resources.description: Catalog of legislative matter types (PEC, PL, PLP, MPV, ...) with full names.

resources.name: ufs
resources.description: The 27 federation units represented in the Senate, with abbreviation, name and region.

prompts.name: panorama_senador
prompts.description: Build an overview of a senator: identity, mandate, committees and recent votes.

prompts.name: acompanhar_materia
prompts.description: Track a legislative matter: current status, processing history and available texts.
